game: BAL @ KC Week 4 2025, kickoff 2025-09-28 16:25 ET, outdoors (Arrowhead). KC +2.5, total 48.5. Weather not in pack.

script.base: Competitive outdoor game, BAL favored by 2.5 with implied totals BAL 25.5 / KC 23.0. Not a blowout and not a 3.5-point dog-pass script. Both offenses stay balanced: Henry (41 carries, 242 yards in weeks 1-3) gets the slight late lean if BAL leads, while Mahomes still feeds Brown (27 targets), Thornton (18) and Kelce (17). A 48.5 total means enough plays for both run games to matter.
script.flip1: KC leads or the game stays tied late. Pacheco/Hunt carries rise and the Pacheco rushyds over survives; BAL's pass volume (Flowers 23 targets / 231 yards) cools if Jackson is not chasing.
script.flip2: BAL leads by 10+ and KC abandons the run. Pacheco and Hunt rush lines die, Mahomes funnels to Kelce/Brown/Thornton, and Henry's clock-kill role gets even larger. This flip kills the Pacheco leg, so the leg is script-dependent on the game staying within one score.

injury_fallout: Source: pre-game nflverse injury report in the pack, plus weeks 1-3 usage. KC DE Michael Danna Doubtful (quad) removes an edge setter vs Henry/Jackson; KC CB Kristian Fulton Questionable (ankle) would help Flowers/Bateman/Hopkins only if inactive (not ruled out); KC DE Ashton Gillotte Questionable is depth. BAL DT Nnamdi Madubuike Out (neck), DE Broderick Washington Out (ankle), DT Travis Jones Questionable (knee) gut the interior in front of a defense already allowing 5.21 YPC — Pacheco (25 carries) and Hunt (23) are the skill-side beneficiaries. BAL FB Patrick Ricard Out (calf) and T Ronnie Stanley Questionable (ankle) hurt Henry's lead blocking and rush efficiency if Stanley sits. BAL TE Isaiah Likely Questionable (foot), not Out, so Andrews (10 targets / 98 yards, games 5, 2, 91) is only a conditional TE sleeper. BAL LB Kyle Van Noy Questionable does not chart to a specific skill matchup here. No inactives lock in the pack.

matchup.shell: No MOFO/MOFC or man/zone charting in the pack. Cannot map Flowers, Brown, Thornton or Kelce to a specific coverage player. Shell read is limited to location YPA.
matchup.pressure: KC blitzes 39%; BAL EPA/db is 0.36 vs blitz and 0.35 vs none, so Jackson is not pressured into checkdowns. BAL blitzes 30%; Mahomes is -0.03 EPA/db vs blitz and +0.24 vs no blitz, so pressure kills KC deep yards (Thornton 453 air yards / 171 receiving) more than it helps them. Madubuike Out and Jones Questionable cut the chance that pressure actually gets home.
matchup.bleeds: KC rush defense 4.30 YPC, 10 runs of 10+ and only 7 passes of 20+ (95 yards); pass YPA left 5.87 (39), middle 6.36 (11), right 7.37 (38) — right side is KC's pass leak, run defense is ordinary not a funnel. BAL rush defense 5.21 YPC and 7 runs of 10+; 12 passes of 20+ (124 yards); YPA left 6.95 (44), middle 9.0 (29), right 5.15 (48). BAL's holes are the interior run and the middle of the field.
matchup.overlap: The clean overlap is KC's committee run game into BAL's 5.21 YPC front with Madubuike out. Kelce (17 targets, 92 air yards, short/intermediate) is the passing overlap with the 9.0 middle YPA, but he is not the primary target (Brown 27, Thornton 18) and the bettable market is yards, not receptions. No alignment chart ties Flowers or Brown to KC's 7.37 right-side YPA, or Thornton to a specific safety.

Thornton 41, 59, 71 vs 59.5 on 453 air yards but only 171 receiving. Kelce 47, 61, 26 vs 47.5 (17/134/92). Andrews 5, 2, 91 vs 5.5. Bateman 10, 15, 63 vs 15.5 on 168 air / 88 yards. Hill rush -14, 7, 0 and rec 3, 18, 45.

edge_players.edge_sentence: Pacheco's 25.5 rush line is below a split-back share against a BAL front allowing 5.21 YPC that is missing Madubuike (Out) with Jones Questionable, and a 2.5-point spread does not force KC to abandon the run.
edge_players.must_be_true: Pacheco keeps about 7-8 of the carries he has averaged (25 in three games, not a Hunt takeover), the game stays within one score so KC does not go pass-only, and the interior is as soft as the 5.21 YPC plus Madubuike's absence. Even at his own 3.68 YPC, 8 carries is about 29 yards.
edge_players.kills_it: BAL leads big (flip 2) and KC abandons the run; Hunt (23 carries, 81 yards, last game 34) or Mahomes (15/128) takes the rushing work; or the 5.21 YPC already fully reflected Madubuike being out and the committee caps him at the 22-yard game.

pre_mortem: It's Monday and Pacheco under 25.5 lost the over. Hunt, already at 23 carries to Pacheco's 25 and coming off 34 rush yards, took early-down and goal-line work, Mahomes kept the scramble carries (15/128 in three weeks), and BAL led so KC threw. The 22- and 25-yard games were the real committee role, the 45 was the script outlier, and 25.5 was a fair number rather than a soft one. Madubuike's absence was already inside the 5.21 YPC, and Jones played. That counter is real but it needs flip 2, not the base 2.5-point game, so the leg stays and is flagged rather than cut.
slip_story: Single-leg 'leaky BAL interior, small spread, KC run stays live' story. It pairs in theory with a competitive-game run stack, but Henry did not survive the pre-mortem, and Flowers/Brown/Thornton overs need the pass-heavy flip this leg loses. No game-total under on the same slip. No 3-4 leg ticket: receptions and TDs are out of market, prices are missing, and only one prop cleared the checklist. Do not size it; no Kelly input without a price.
